title: fed balance sheet / reserve management purchases / ample reserves | Speech Neutral | Reflections on the Early Days of Reserve Management Purchase...
summary: Federal Reserve SOMA Manager Roberto Perli delivered remarks on the transition from abundant to ample reserves, explaining that the FOMC decided at its October 2025 meeting to conclude balance sheet runoff effective December 1, and subsequently instructed the Desk to begin reserve management purchases (RMPs) to maintain reserves within the ample range. Perli detailed how system liquidity fell to the lowest levels since runoff began due to TGA rebuild and cumulative balance sheet reduction, causing repo rates to rise sustainably above EFFR and triggering increased usage of standing repo operations.
